gates.reason: Inspected the full route contract test: it verifies origin and CSRF enforcement, enterprise read/write scope separation, JSON content type and body-size limits, fail-closed validation, sanitized persistence, bounded responses, and disables LLM egress while using isolated temporary Claude data.

The test reproducibly checks timestamp bounds, server-side elapsed-time recomputation, sanitized append-only records, efficacy arithmetic, and explicit structured provenance for complete and budget-exceeded reads.
